summary: Comprehensive test suite covering all major requirements: parsing (package.json/requirements.txt), license lookup with mocks, allow/deny classification, report generation, CLI wiring, and GitHub Actions integration via act. Unit tests are well-organized by functionality with good isolation; end-to-end tests validate workflow structure, actionlint compliance, and exact output parsing. Strengths: clear test naming, robust fixture management (tempfile), TDD methodology evident in structure, error scenarios tested (missing files, unsupported formats, graceful exit codes), mixed unit + integration approach. Minor gaps: no tests for malformed JSON in config files, limited version operator coverage (missing ~=, !=, <, >), no special character or very large manifest testing. Act output parsing has minor fragility (assumes specific format for JSON extraction and CHECKER_EXIT env var) but is well-documented. Would reliably catch regressions in core logic flow and most edge cases, though some subtle input variations could slip through.
